Note: Lead days of 1 day are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 1 day after contract genera tion date. 7.2 PERIOD OF WORK: 7.2.1 To and Fro transportation shall be 2 days for each occasion. 7.2.2 Machining of Turbo Generator Oil guards shall be 1 day for each oil guard 7.2.3 Machining of 4 coupling bolts or part there of shall be one day. 7.2.4 Machining of MOP Bearing shall be 1 day per bearing. 7.2.5 Machining of MOP wear ring shall be 1 day per wear ring. 7.2.6 Machining of Turbine casing keys shall be 1 day per key. 7.2.7 However early completion work will be appreciated. The above period of transit and machining is inclusive of collection of items at TPS-II Expn site and returning the same after the completion of machinin g to TPS-II Expn site. 8.0 PAYMENT TERMS 100 % payment will be made within 30 days after receipt of material at Thermal Station II Expansion site and acceptance by NLCIL of the duly machined items an d on submission of necessary invoice. 9.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence.
